Subject: Cutting alert noise for your engineering team

Hi [First Name],

When alerts fire all day, engineers start tuning them out, and eventually a real incident slips past.

I'm [Your Name] from [Company]. We run a log-monitoring service that flags the alerts worth acting on and filters out the rest. In our pilot, alert noise dropped by 60%, so on-call engineers were interrupted less often and could spend more time on actual problems.

Pricing starts at $49 a month, so you can start small without a big commitment. There's also a 14-day trial, which lets you connect your own logs and see the results for yourself. About 30 customers already use us for their day-to-day monitoring.

If your team spends a lot of time separating real issues from false alarms, I think it's worth a quick look. Would you be open to a 15-minute call next week to see whether it fits your stack? If the timing doesn't work, I can send a short overview for you to read when you have time.
